name: AgentRewardBench
purpose: offline selection-layer and correlated-judge calibration only
limitations: This is a web-agent trajectory benchmark, not a coding-agent end-to-end benchmark.
It measures judge selection and correlated errors; it has no repair delta.
Judgment records have token and partial dollar cost but no comparable wall time.
Hidden coding benchmark labels must never be exposed to GRAFT online selection.
terms: Research use is subject to the upstream fair-use Terms of Use; derivatives must retain those terms and no raw data is redistributed here.
